name: ai-study-assistant-mobile
description: Nexus Study — AI Self-Study Assistant mobile app (iOS + Android)

scripts.build:android: cd frontend-mobile && eas build --platform android --profile production --non-interactive
scripts.build:ios: cd frontend-mobile && eas build --platform ios --profile production --non-interactive
scripts.verify: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm backend:test
scripts.backend:install: cd backend && python -m venv venv && . venv/bin/activate && pip install -e .
